chapters.title: 3. Recommended Remediation Roadmap
chapters.purpose: Present concrete, prioritized engineering actions (`P0` urgent -> `P1` high-value -> `P2` polish) with exact target files, expected impact, and traceability to rule IDs / CVEs.
required_diagrams: Action Plan Traceability Matrix (`Table`: Priority, Action Title, `target_files`, `expected_impact`, and `related_rules`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **Remediation Action Plan (Pre-Sorted `P0 -> P1 -> P2`, total=5)**:

1. `[P1]` **Enforce authentication and tenant authorization on /v1/orders endpoints** (`security`, targets=['src/order_dispatch/api/routes.py'], related_rules=['common/security_vulnerability', 'CWE-306']): Introduce an OAuth2/JWT or mTLS caller principal dependency on POST /v1/orders and GET /v1/orders/{order_id} to resolve CWE-306 and the line 73 TODO. (Impact: Prevents unauthorized order creation and cross-tenant order enumeration.)

2. `[P1]` **Refresh Dockerfile base image, adopt multi-stage build without pip, and add HEALTHCHECK** (`security`, targets=['Dockerfile'], related_rules=['common/security_vulnerability', 'SEC-01', 'SEC-02', 'CVE-2026-42010', 'CVE-2026-31789', 'CVE-2026-8643']): Update python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm to the latest patched 3.12 slim digest, copy only the built venv into a clean runtime stage (eliminating pip@24.2 CVEs), and add HEALTHCHECK for /healthz. (Impact: Eliminates all 6 pip CVEs, resolves patchable Debian OS CRITICAL CVEs, and clears Trivy DS-0026.)

3. `[P2]` **Add durable OrderRepository adapter for multi-replica production deployments** (`architecture`, targets=['src/order_dispatch/main.py', 'src/order_dispatch/infra/repository.py'], related_rules=['common/twelve_factor']): Implement a persistent OrderRepository adapter (PostgreSQL/Redis) wired via ServiceSettings in prod mode so processes remain strictly stateless. (Impact: Enables zero-data-loss restarts and horizontal replica scaling under 12-Factor VI.)

4. `[P2]` **Add HTTP security headers middleware and gate /openapi.json in production** (`security`, targets=['src/order_dispatch/main.py'], related_rules=['common/security_vulnerability', 'SEC-06', 'CWE-693', 'CWE-200']): Add lightweight HTTP middleware setting X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY, and set openapi_url=None when settings.env == 'prod'. (Impact: Resolves live DAST CWE-693 and CWE-200 baseline hardening findings.)

5. `[P2]` **Add FastAPI TestClient and httpx MockTransport tests for HTTP/lifespan branches** (`testing`, targets=['tests/test_routes.py', 'src/order_dispatch/api/routes.py', 'src/order_dispatch/infra/webhook_client.py'], related_rules=['common/runtime_verification']): Exercise /healthz, POST /v1/orders, GET /v1/orders/{id} (including 404), lifespan startup/shutdown, and httpx.HTTPError fallback via MockTransport. (Impact: Raises measured branch coverage from 62.5% to >=80% and closes HTTP boundary gaps.)
